sonuclar.tahmin_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM orders;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers;

SELECT 
    order_status, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
    orders
GROUP BY 
    order_status;

SELECT 
  SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  orders
  JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  month;

SELECT 
    p.product_category_name,
    t.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS ciro
FROM 
    order_items oi
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
    product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    p.product_category_name,
    t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
    ciro DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp))::numeric::decimal AS ortalama_teslim_suresi
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS perc_delivered_late
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
    customers.customer_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM 
    customers
GROUP BY 
    customers.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    musteri_sayisi DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    order_payments.payment_type, 
    SUM(order_payments.payment_value) AS total_paid
FROM 
    order_payments
JOIN 
    orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id
GROUP BY 
    order_payments.payment_type;

SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS ortalama_degerlendirme_puani
FROM 
  order_reviews
JOIN 
  orders ON order_reviews.order_id = orders.order_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sellers.seller_id)
FROM sellers;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name_english)
FROM product_category_name_translation;

SELECT MAX(price) AS en_pahalı_fiyat
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sellers.seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM 
    sellers
GROUP BY 
    sellers.seller_state;

SELECT 
    review_score, 
    COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM 
    order_reviews
GROUP BY 
    review_score
ORDER BY 
    review_score;

SELECT 
    payment_installments, 
    COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM 
    order_payments
WHERE 
    payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY 
    payment_installments
ORDER BY 
    frequency DESC;

SELECT 
    geolocation_city, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS siparis_sayisi
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
JOIN 
    geolocation ON customers.customer_zip_code_prefix = geolocation.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY 
    geolocation_city
ORDER BY 
    siparis_sayisi DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    c.customer_state, 
    SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS ortalama_sepet
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_state
ORDER BY 
    ortalama_sepet DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_id,
    SUM(order_items.price) AS ciro
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
JOIN 
    sellers ON order_items.seller_id = sellers.seller_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    sellers.seller_id
ORDER BY 
    ciro DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS mesafe_ay,
  SUM(order_items.price) AS aylık_ciro
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  order_purchase_timestamp BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2018-03-31'
  AND orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  mesafe_ay;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS day_of_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(DOW FROM orders.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
    order_count DESC;

SELECT 
    geolocation_state, 
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) AS teslimat_suresi
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
JOIN 
    geolocation ON customers.customer_zip_code_prefix = geolocation.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
WHERE 
    order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL 
    AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    teslimat_suresi DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COUNT(order_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customers.customer_unique_id) >= 2 THEN customers.customer_unique_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT customers.customer_unique_id) AS tekrar_eden_musteri_orani
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered';
